sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** FY26 guides Novo's first sales decline in decades; CagriSema lost its head-to-head to Zepbound; MFN plus ex-US generics plus Lilly's pending oral pill permanently reset growth and margins — at 10.8x TTM the fair frame is "ex-growth pharma" and only the dividend remains.

**Why wrong (at the margin):** the guided decline is a disclosed price/rebate-mechanics reset, and H1-26 CONFIRMS the components — ex-340B −4.2% vs a −4/−12% guide, obesity care still growing (+22% CER in Q1), FCF 54.4bn above the guide, net debt falling. That is execution ON the cyclical path, not structural collapse. BUT the structural doubt is not baseless (REDEFINE 4, orforglipron) — the variant is narrow, and my own base ($38) validating spot means the mispricing is in the re-rating odds, not the base case.

**What proves us wrong:** FY27 opening guidance (Feb-27) showing a second consecutive CER decline; quarterly obesity care <10% CER; a CagriSema complete-response letter; Lilly oral approval crushing Wegovy oral before scale.

**Edge taxonomy:** (c) time-arbitrage — the market cannot hold a 2-4y view through a guided 12-month decline whose components (price reset vs volume) are already separated in the primary numbers; (a) analytical — reported-vs-adjusted decomposition from H1-26 data. No (b)/(d). **Honest cap:** the decomposition is diagnostic, not a valuation — it says the de-rating is cyclically explainable, not that spot is cheap; at −1.6pp/yr equity-risk premium the edge is currently unpayable.

3. CagriSema failed primary non-inferiority to Zepbound in REDEFINE 4 (NCT06131437: 23.0% vs 25.5% weight loss) — documented head-to-head loss; share is being lost as well as de-rated.
4. Fed delivered +25bp to 3.75-4.00% with DXY at its 52-week high (the macro regime memo 2026-10-03) — long-duration/high-P/E multiples under live, hostile pressure; the discount-rate tail is one-directional down for this window.

It is ~Oct-2029 and this position lost ~55% (hit kill $16.59). Most likely: FY27 guidance confirmed a second CER decline — semaglutide generics beyond Canada/Brazil/China (India), MFN ratcheting further, orforglipron approved before Wegovy oral reaches scale, CagriSema a CRL — the "cyclical" read was wrong and the bear endpoint was reached. Second: a dividend cut if FY26 FCF lands at guide bottom against the 51.8bn payout plus ~55bn capex. Either way the honest lesson: we bought ON the guided trough at a price that merely EQUALLED base-case fair value; the multiple never re-rated because 10.8x was already fair for the ex-growth read, and 3.9% cash beat the 2.3%-premium equity over 3 years.
